choice.title: Bring in your existing chats?
choice.intro: WhatsApp sends a number's chat history only once, right after the number is first linked. Choose now, before you scan.
choice.label: Import existing chats
choice.noneHelp: Only new messages appear in the shared inbox. This is the default.
choice.recentHelp: The recent chats WhatsApp sends when a number is first linked, with the people in them.
choice.full: Yes, as much as WhatsApp sends
choice.fullHelp: Also WhatsApp's older history. It takes longer and uses more of your contact limit.
choice.pointQuiet: Imported chats are marked read and stay silent: no alerts, no automations and no automatic replies.
choice.pointMedia: Photos, videos, voice messages and files are not imported. You will see a placeholder such as [Photo].
choice.pointGroups: Group chats are saved as group conversations and do not create contacts.
choice.pointConsent: Imported people are not marked as having agreed to marketing messages.
choice.pointLimit: Imported people count towards your plan's contact limit. The import stops cleanly if it is reached.
choice.pointTime: It can take a few minutes. You can keep working, and you can cancel at any time.
choice.pointOnce: Linking the number again imports only if you choose to import again before you scan.

result.note: Your chats are being imported. Follow the progress on the number's page.

card.title: Imported chats

body.not_requested: This number did not import its chats. WhatsApp offers history only when a number is first linked, so choose it the next time you link this number.
body.idle: Waiting for the number to be linked and for WhatsApp to send its chats. This can take a few minutes.
body.running: Importing chats. You can leave this page, the import continues.
body.done: The import is finished. The chats are in the shared inbox, marked as read.
body.failed: The import did not finish. What was imported stays in the inbox.
body.cancelled: You stopped the import. What was imported stays in the inbox.
body.limit_reached: The import stopped because your plan's contact limit was reached. What was imported stays in the inbox.

card.window: Messages from the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
card.mediaNote: Photos, videos, voice messages and files are not imported. Their place shows a placeholder.
card.cancelMessage: No more chats will be taken. What was already imported stays in the inbox.
card.cancelDone: Import stopped. What was imported stays in the inbox.

error.history_not_received: WhatsApp did not send any chat history. It does so only when a number is first linked. Link the number again and choose to import to try again.
error.message_cap_reached: Stopped at the limit of messages for one number. What was imported stays.
error.chat_cap_reached: Stopped at the limit of chats for one number. What was imported stays.
error.contact_limit_reached: Stopped because your plan's contact limit was reached. Free some contacts or upgrade, then link the number again and import.
error.worker_error: The import stopped because of an error. What was imported stays. Link the number again to try again.

errors.HISTORY_IMPORT_NOT_ACTIVE: There is no import running for this number.
